items.html: And it seems to me, from what it says, 'that the holy King should couple with the Matronita' — namely the Mayin Nukvin that go out through the Yesod, the springs of the well and the foundation, and they arouse the coupling for the King to couple with the Matronita; that is what it says 'my spikenard,' which is her Yesod; and that is 'sent forth its fragrance,' from below upward, like the matter of the scent.
